title: Blocked run message should end with the exact command to continue
body:
What happened: When a run is blocked, the block message does not say how to continue. The agent has to guess the next command.

What I expected: The block message ends with the exact command a person types to continue, for example `warden retry <task>`.

Steps to repeat:
1. Start a task and let it reach a blocked state.
2. Read the block message.
3. Notice there is no command at the end telling what to type next.

Evidence: Seen on ticket PG-104. The block message ended without any continue command, so the agent guessed.
note: Fixed. A blocked task now ends with how to continue.
